title: Passive-region activation quarantine and circuit-breaker choreography
creator: Lena Chen
description: Purpose: define a detailed, testable playbook for promoting a passive region to active with a quarantine validation window, plus a choreography of circuit-breaker and load-shedding changes to keep user-facing SLOs intact. This ticket captures runbook steps, preflight checks, automated verification queries, rollback criteria, and post-drill reporting expectations. Background: we operate an active-primary (us-east-1) and passive-standby (eu-west-1) topology for our hosted API. Recent exercises uncovered inconsistent KV cache priming and an unclear order for toggling circuit-breakers and global routing. Goal: create a reproducible checklist and automated verification harness so on-call and SREs can safely run scheduled failover drills with minimal customer impact and measurable safety nets.
scope: All hosted API production services behind the global edge (API gateway, proxy, model-serving pools, tokenstore, and metadata DB). Includes DNS promotion (weighted routing), route53 health checks, circuit-breaker toggles, load-shedding rules, and data-integrity verification for tokenstore and embeddings store.
out_of_scope: Dedicated customer private deployments and on-prem packages. Full restore-from-backup of archival cold backups (separate DR runbook).
success_metrics: <= 5 minute customer-visible outage for non-critical requests during drill
No data loss detected by end-to-end object ingestion+readback tests
Automated verification completes within 20 minutes post-swap
Runbook completes without manual rollback in >= 80% of scheduled drills
slo_checks_to_monitor: request-per-second drop-off on passive region post-activation
replication lag seconds for primary->replica DBs
preflight_checks: Validate latest automated backup exists and md5 matches expected manifest on s3://redwood-dr-backups
Confirm KMS key access in passive region for all services (test decrypt/encrypt)
Verify route53 weighted records and CloudFront origin groups are healthy
Ensure model-serving pools in passive region are at desired capacity and pass self-check
Confirm circuit-breaker policy version deployed (cb-policy:v3) and can be toggled via feature flag
Run quick tokenstore read/write smoke test to passive region endpoints
activation_checklist: Step 0: Notify stakeholders and runbook channel; set drill flag in Incident Board
Step 1: Place primary region into graceful-deprecation mode: reduce new traffic by 20% for 2 minutes
Step 2: Activate passive region model-serving pools (scale up to baseline) and validate health endpoints
Step 3: Flip circuit-breaker choreography: enable conservative CB profile in passive region (drop-by-latency) and enable cross-region fallback throttles
Step 4: Swap route53 weight to 50/50 for 5 minutes, then to 90 passive for the quarantine window
Step 5: Run data-consistency queries (see verification queries) and KV cache priming procedure
Step 6: Monitor SLO dashboards and run automated synthetic tests for 15 minutes
Step 7: If green, increase weight to 100% passive; otherwise trigger rollback (see rollback criteria)
rollback_criteria: Error-rate > 1% sustained for 5 minutes on production API
Replication lag > 30s for more than 2 minutes
Critical endpoint p95 latency > 2x baseline for 5 minutes
Automated verification fails more than one end-to-end ingestion/readback test
circuit_breaker_and_load_shedding: Use cb-policy:v3 with staged thresholds: (1) read-only soft-open, (2) progressive throttling by route, (3) hard-open for non-critical routes
During quarantine window enable request-weight-based shedding for long-running routes (embeddings/re-ranking) at 30%
Prioritize traffic: interactive chat > inference-batch > embeddings in shedding order
Expose emergency override to on-call via SRE Ops Console (requires 2FA confirmation)
verification_queries: Tokenstore write-read verification: create test-token-<runId> then read and compare TTL and metadata
Embeddings store ingest/lookup: embed known vector set and confirm top-k recall >= 0.95
Model response sanity: run 10 sample prompts and confirm deterministic signature + schema validation
DB read-after-write: write marker row to metadata DB and confirm across replicas
automated_tests_and_tools: drill-runner: CI job that orchestrates weighted DNS swaps and collects metrics
kv-priming tool: warms tokenstore caches using production-like prefix distributions
slo-checker: dashboard widgets and slack alerts (p95/p99/error-rate)
chaos-safeguard: circuit-breaker safe-release that gates full promotion
test_plan_summary: Run a scheduled drill in the next maintenance window: 10m preflight, 30m activation with 15m quarantine verification, then 20m tear-down. Execute the automated tests in the order: preflight smoke -> activation checklist -> verification queries -> synthetic traffic ramp -> post-checks. Capture metrics and logs into s3://redwood-dr-drill-results/<runId>/
post_drill_reporting: Attach run artifacts to the incident ticket (metrics snapshots, synthetic test output, logs)
Fill postmortem template: timeline, decisions made, root causes, action items
Schedule follow-up to fix any validation gaps within 2 cycles
